title: Commission Tier/Flat — importing an export fails with a raw duplicate-key error (NM-3425 regression)
requirementSource: NM-3425: import must handle existing / duplicate bands gracefully and report clear success and error counts
stepsToReproduce: Open Setup → Commissions → Tier/Flat for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/commissions/tiers) on e2e and click Search.
Click Import and choose that same file, unchanged.
expectedBehavior: The import reports success (and counts); nothing changes, as every band already exists.
actualBehavior: The upload starts on file choice, the progress bar stops at 50% and the dialog shows "Unexpected error: An item with the same key has already been added. Key: 1101" — a raw server exception, no counts. A file with invalid values (negative boundary, 150 %) gets the same message instead of row errors.
affectedTests: TC-COM-TF-074 (refused, but with the raw exception)

verificationLog.finding: Isolated rerun after the import wait was fixed; a 60-second watch of the dialog showed the message never changes and nothing is stored.
